subject: Eigen matrix package in R (Doug Bates & Dir Eddelbuettel)

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Eigen matrix package in R (Doug Bates & Dir Eddelbuettel)
parts:
This was sent to the Eigen mailing list by
Doug Bates and Dirk Eddlbuettel. I replied
to Dirk's comment on Andrew's blog entry that
we were also using Rcpp thanks to Malecki's
guidance (and help).

I think Doug's planning to rewrite lmer using
Eigen because it's faster and more flexible than
whatever he was using before. He's been pretty active
on the Eigen list (and I hope he pushes through some
of the proposed changes for symmetric matrices, as
they'll help us in the Stan implementation).

- Bob

-------- Original Message --------
Subject: [eigen] Paper regarding availability of Eigen classes from R
Date: Thu, 1 Dec 2011 12:25:55 -0600
From: Douglas Bates <ba...@stat.wisc.edu>
Reply-To: ei...@lists.tuxfamily.org
To: ei...@lists.tuxfamily.org
CC: Dirk Eddelbuettel <e...@debian.org>

R (www.R-project.org) is an interpreted language widely used in
statistical computing and Bioinformatics. It can be extended with
contributed packages, many of which are made available through CRAN,
the Comprehensive R Archive Network.

Dirk Eddelbuettel, Romain Francois and I have contributed a package
RcppEigen that includes Eigen, release 3.0.3, and some "glue" using
Rcpp classes to allow communication between R and the compiled C++
code. Dirk and I wrote an introduction, available as
http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/RcppEigen/RcppEigen.pdf,
introducing the R package and Eigen classes. In particular we compare
several approaches to obtaining least squares solutions through
decompositions available in Eigen.

We would welcome suggestions regarding the code or the presentation.

parts:
A recent change in the rforge repository versions of lme4, lme4a, and lme4Eigen causes the following on all platforms — this also breaks blme:

Error in dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...) : 
  function 'cholmod_l_start' not provided by package 'Matrix'

I haven't gotten to the very very bottom of this.

Also, I'm planning to pick back up on Rcpp/RStan after Hadley’s R class on the 12–13. :)

M
